method: curl-based multi-viewport HTML analysis (Playwright remote WS unreachable — ws://51.254.244.216:3000/). Used mobile + desktop UA header analysis, deep HTML structure analysis, Bootstrap grid pattern detection, media query extraction from inline CSS.
scenario: Category product listing page responsive grid + Login/Register page responsive analysis + Search results page responsive analysis + English homepage i18n responsive verification — NEW scenario not covered by previous tests at 0100, 0115, 0130, 0145, 0200
anti_duplicate_note: Previous tests: 0100 (mobile perf/PDP), 0115 (visual viewport 390+768), 0130 (login flow mobile+desktop), 0145 (PDP+pricing+search+category tornos structural), 0200 (homepage hero/grid + vendor directory + contact + CMS pages). Este test es NUEVO: (1) Category tornos listing grid + sidebar responsive, (2) Login form responsive + OAuth buttons, (3) Search results featured listings grid, (4) English homepage i18n responsive verification, (5) Listing card sub-element analysis.

scenarios_tested: Category page (/es/15-tornos) — product listing responsive grid: zcnc-listing-row structure (12 items), left sidebar filters (d-none d-md-block), mobile filter offcanvas toggle, breadcrumb nav, pagination responsive, header/footer responsive

Login Page (/es/iniciar-sesion) — login form responsive layout: container--limited-sm, buttons-wrapper--invert-mobile, OAuth Google button, register prompt, form input classes, header/footer responsive

Search Page (/es/buscar) — search results responsive: zcnc-listings-list container (18 featured listings), ps-searchbar--mobile, filter actions mobile button, sidebar facets offcanvas, header/footer responsive
English Homepage (/en/) — i18n responsive: hero section, categories grid (zcnc-categories-grid), steps grid (zcnc-steps-grid), banner strips, same responsive patterns as Spanish version

Listing Card Structure Analysis — zcnc-listing-row sub-elements: zcnc-row-image, zcnc-row-category, zcnc-row-desc, zcnc-row-location, zcnc-row-price, zcnc-row-specs, zcnc-row-actions, zcnc-row-link, zcnc-row-info, zcnc-row-price-col

summary: Responsive structure is CORRECT across all 4 tested pages (category listing, login, search, English homepage). All pages have viewport meta, Bootstrap 5 responsive grid, mobile offcanvas navigation, responsive footer with accordion collapse, proper media query breakpoints at 991px and 768px. Key findings: (1) Category page has proper sidebar → offcanvas filter pattern, (2) Login form has responsive buttons with invert-mobile ordering, (3) Search page has mobile search offcanvas + mobile filter button, (4) English homepage has consistent responsive structure. Re-confirmed issues: (1) No srcset/sizes on images (RESP-SRCSET-01), (2) Cache no-store for all pages (expected but could improve with asset caching).
